source_family: World Bank Indicators API / WDI plus non-IMF-linked source series where available (WIPO, UNESCO/UIS, SIPRI, IEA, infrastructure/transport) and conservative PPP/price-level cross-checks

domestic_credit_private_gdp.label: Domestic credit to private sector (% of GDP)

labor_force_participation.label: Labor force participation rate, total (% ages 15+)

exports_gdp.label: Exports of goods and services (% of GDP)

r_and_d_gdp.label: Research and development expenditure (% of GDP)

ppp_price_level_ratio.label: Price level index (GDP), divided by 100 for conservative PPP ratio

ppp_gdp_conversion_factor.label: PPP conversion factor, GDP (LCU per international $)

ppp_private_consumption_factor.label: PPP conversion factor, private consumption (LCU per international $)

manufacturing_mass_score.label: Log-normalized manufacturing value-added mass score vs largest country-year producer

industry_mass_score.label: Log-normalized industry value-added mass score vs largest country-year producer

patent_applications_mass_score.label: Log-normalized resident patent-application mass score vs largest country-year producer

container_port_mass_score.label: Log-normalized container-port throughput mass score vs largest country-year port system

rail_lines_mass_score.label: Log-normalized rail-route infrastructure mass score vs largest country-year rail network

model_notes.no_demo_data: No synthetic country records or demo values are written. Derived layers use only present live-source inputs and emit null when needed inputs are absent.
model_notes.productive_capacity_score: 0-100 physical productive capacity proxy from manufacturing/industry value-added mass and GDP share, production momentum, manufactured/export complexity, technical depth, and a smaller real-growth term.
model_notes.sovereign_coherence_score: 0-100 conservative proxy for revealed state/build capacity from physical production, technical depth, logistics/energy infrastructure, and limited strategic allocation inputs. It is not a claim about ideology or military effectiveness.
model_notes.capacity_shield_score: The stronger of productive capacity and sovereign coherence, used conservatively to reduce false dust/noise attribution.
model_notes.ppp_adjustment: Conservative PPP/price-level adjustment from PA.NUS.GDP.PLI divided by 100. Low domestic price levels only nudge already-observed physical mass upward by at most 12%; high price levels can apply a small cost drag. It does not invent capacity where physical-production signals are absent.
model_notes.productive_inflation: max(CPI inflation,0) multiplied by the physical productive capacity score, not GDP growth alone.
model_notes.retention_drag: Residual positive inflation after productive component, weighted by present debt-service, government-expense, and negative-growth pressure scores.
model_notes.symbolic_inflation: Residual positive inflation weighted by smooth broad-money/GDP and private-credit/GDP financialization scores. The old hard-clipped finance score is retained as legacy_financialization_score for audit only.
model_notes.measurement_robust_s2_score: Measurement-robust S2 stress score from CPI/GDP-deflator cross-check, broad-money growth, hidden labor slack, debt/overhead, weak growth, and smoothed finance depth. This does not truly reverse hedonics or national methodology; it reduces dependence on any single official series.
model_notes.official_cleaned_toggle: The app exposes a global Official/Cleaned toggle. Official mode uses direct World Bank series. Cleaned mode uses the measurement-adjusted proxy input set for all layers, including dynamics and flows.
model_notes.economic_distortion_index: 0-100 truth-oriented conservative S2 audit index. It compares official projection against cleaned cross-checks, accounting divergence, structural masking, and revealed build capacity. High means official health may be overstated relative to deeper live-source S2 signals; it is not proof of intentional lying.
model_notes.measurement_divergence_score: CPI-vs-GDP-deflator divergence plus labor slack cross-checks from participation/employment signals.
model_notes.dust_index: 0-100 maintenance/overhead proxy from present debt, finance, government expense, unemployment, and negative-growth pressures, partially offset by measured physical productive capacity.
model_notes.coherence_score: 100 minus present pressure scores from inflation deviation, debt, finance, labor slack, negative growth, and missing capacity shield. Higher is more coherent.
model_notes.dynamics_layer: Yearly cluster states and inferred regional pressure-gradient arcs from historical live-source indicators. Arcs are not measured trade/capital flows; they are visual hypotheses from retention-pressure gradients.
